title: Grateful Dead Live at Cumberland County Civic Center on 1982-09-17
lineage: MAC > Nakamichi DR-8 > Edirol FA-66 > Wavelab > CD-Wave > R8Brain > TLH > FLAC 2496
source: 3x Nakamichi CM300's > Nakamichi 550 > Maxell XLII-S. Set up in the row of tapers directly behind the soundboard

ai_review.summary: High‑energy Maine show with a cooking Bertha opener and a blistering Dew > Sugar finale, captured on an okay‑quality fan recording.
ai_review.review: The concert is hailed as a classic by multiple reviewers, noting Jerry Garcia’s first‑class solos (especially on "Deal" and the extended "Dew > Sugar"), a powerful Bertha opener, and a darkly foreboding "Estimated." While the performance is described as one of the best shows in Maine, the tape quality is only noted as “okay,” with no major technical complaints.

ai_rating.rationale: All three reviews are 5‑star and overwhelmingly praise the performance; recording quality is only described as acceptable, so the rating reflects an excellent show with decent but not outstanding audio.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewer says "Quality is okay" and provides no detailed sound issues; no mention of soundboard or audience source.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong, high‑energy flow with a memorable opener and an epic closing sequence; reviewers emphasize the seamless transitions and overall excitement.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Multiple mentions of Jerry's solos being blistering, first class, and sweet (especially on Deal).
band_member_comments.Bob: Bobby (Bob Weir) pulled his A‑game alongside Jerry.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent (Mydland) did not sing this night; no specific comment on his playing.
